'''Kinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he used the alias Triar to work against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Sharune]].<ref name="Far Horizons" />
